utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, I'm trying to get a clear picture on this repair drive—Opal says it's happening tomorrow near Elm and Birch, but I've been telling folks this weekend. You know anything?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Jules, Leo said the repair drive is this Saturday starting at 9 AM, not tomorrow. We're set for the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, that's a relief—thanks for clearing that up, Sam! I'll let Opal know it's Saturday, not tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I think I started organizing it... but I can't quite remember where I put the sign-up sheet. Did I leave it at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I think it's this Saturday at the community center. Want me to help you find that sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That'd be great, Ira! I think I might've left it near the front desk... or maybe in the lost and found pile by accident.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Faye, I heard you're bringing a lamp to the repair drive—what kind is it?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's an old brass desk lamp with a frayed cord—nothing fancy, but it's been in the family for years. I'm hoping someone can fix it up!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a family heirloom! I've got some wrenches I'm bringing—maybe we can trade fixing tips!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I've got a list here of everyone who signed up, if you want to double-check we're not missing anyone.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Uli. Let's check that list — I want to make sure I'm on it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course you're on it, Dane. You're right here — see? Want to help me organize these tools while we wait for the others?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Kira, do you have the confirmed schedule for the repair drive? I need to plan my day around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I'm still waiting for some official word on that. Have you seen any fliers or notices from the neighborhood association?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, I haven't seen any fliers yet. I'm hoping Faye can pull it all together soon.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've still got that power washer if you think it'll help clean up the damage before we assess how deep it goes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, the power washer might come in handy—let's just make sure the crew can reach that fence spot by the oak tree without any hassle.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I'll bring the power washer and some extension cords, just in case we need to reach that spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I heard a little about it. What's it all about?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's this Saturday at the community center! We're all getting together to fix it up, and we'd love your help. Can you come?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds great, Quinn. I can come, and I've got some old tools I could bring to help out.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, the repair drive is Saturday. Need anything fixed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Leo, I believe the repair drive is actually on Sunday, not Saturday. I got it from Rosa herself.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hm, Rosa told me Saturday. Let me double-check with her.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still worried about whether we'll have enough volunteers to cover the whole day, Rosa. Has everyone confirmed their shifts?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Don't you worry, Pia! I've got Leo, Mara, and a few others on the list, and I'll keep checking in with folks to make sure we're all set for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good to hear, Rosa, but I'd feel better if we had a written schedule. Could you share the list with me so I can double-check the time slots?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, the repair drive is definitely this Saturday! I saw it on the community board near the park—it's going to be a great chance for us to fix stuff together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, this Saturday? I guess I must have mixed up the dates. Well, I'll try to remember to bring that broken chair.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's perfect, Noah! Bring that chair and I'll make sure we have all the tools we need. I've been telling everyone I see about it, so it'll be a busy day!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I'll look for those tarps, but I still need to know—did you actually see the damage on the main drive? Is it worth us pooling money for a real fix?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven't seen the damage myself, but the repair drive is more about sharing spare parts and fixing things together. Those tarps would really help us cover the donations.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Has anyone actually seen the damage? I need to know before I decide about money.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ah, I see, so there are two efforts going on—community center and shed repairs. Have we figured out if folks need to sign up for one or the other, or just bring everything to the center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I think it's all at the community center! The Smiths said just bring everything there—they'll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Good, that makes it simpler. I'll tell Mina and Dane to bring their items straight to the center on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday? I've been telling everyone about it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's on. I've got the inventory sorted with Faye.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great that you and Faye have the inventory sorted! I'll keep spreading the word so we get a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Noah! The repair drive? I think it's this Saturday... or maybe Sunday? I wrote it down somewhere, but I can't find my notes.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Sunday? I'm even more confused now. I thought I saw a flyer, but maybe I just imagined it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, I'm sure I had it written down. Let me check my pockets—or maybe it's on the fridge at home?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? Yeah, I think I pointed out that fence spot by the oak tree—should be fine for the crew to find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that'll make it easier for everyone to find. I'll make sure to mark it on the map we're putting together.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Cool, thanks Sam. I gotta run—let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive are we talking about, Jules? The community center fix or the shed project? I want to be sure before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It's the community center fix, Hana! I'm rounding folks up to get that done this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, community center it is. I'll check the repair drive this afternoon and meet you there at 3 to see what we need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, hey Rey! I keep hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—sounds like folks are really pitching in with tools and stuff.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, it's nice to see everyone coming together. Cleo's been busy organizing it all.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I heard even Faye's bringing a lamp—seems like everyone's got something to contribute.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, just heard about the repair drive—need any help with planning?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Dane, glad you asked! The repair drive is actually tomorrow, not the weekend—near Elm and Birch. I'd appreciate an extra pair of eyes to make sure the crew finds the right spot for that old fence.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Tomorrow? Got it, I'll be there early. Any particular tools I should bring for the fence?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, I'm glad you're here! We're gathering supplies for the repair drive—do you have any spare tarps or tools we could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've got a couple of tarps in the shed you can borrow. Have you set a definite schedule yet? I like to have my day planned out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not yet, but I'm thinking this Saturday morning. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, glad to help out with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Gus! Don't forget to bring your tools by Saturday morning—we'll put them to good use.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You bet, I'll have the wagon loaded and ready to roll first thing Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll start sorting the wrenches—keep the adjustable ones separate from the fixed sizes.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Uli, and I'll come around with the labels once you have them grouped. This is going to make the repair drive run so smoothly!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks Rosa, that'll help everyone find what they need fast.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, is the repair drive for the community center or for fixing that cracked pipe? I need to know what we're actually pooling money for.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: It's not about pooling money, Mina—it's about bringing in broken items and fixing them together. The community center is hosting it, but the pipe issue is separate.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So there's no plan to fix the pipe? I thought we were all chipping in for that, but it sounds like we're not on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well Kira, I heard it from the Smiths themselves—they're definitely doing it this Saturday at the community center. I can check with them for fliers if you want!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, Tess, if the Smiths are really behind it, maybe it's legit. But I still want to see a flyer or something official before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I totally get that, Kira! I'll swing by the Smiths' place later and grab a flyer for you—I promise it's happening, but seeing is believing, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, I was just at the store and ran into Jules—she's putting together a group for the repair drive on Saturday. You planning to come lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I'll be there bright and early—I'm actually coordinating the whole thing, so I've been counting on folks like Jules to help rally everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice, so you're the one at the helm! That's great—I'll make sure to bring some tools and a good attitude on Saturday.
